Pinpoint Control.name: Pinpoint Control
Pinpoint Control.description:
🎯 You place your Quirk exactly where you mean it.

✨ A narrow strike past a hostage, a gentle touch, a partial use on demand.
📋 Requires level 16 and Quirk Control 22.
🚫 Not available to Quirkless characters.

📈 Grants: Quirk Control +10
Pinpoint Control.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has refined fine control of their Quirk: they can shrink its area, dial its force down to what the moment needs, aim it past an ally or a hostage and stop it the instant they decide. Show precision in small details: an effect that ends exactly at a line, a strike that bruises instead of breaking bone, a use so measured it looks easy. Limits: precision adds no range or power, and fatigue, panic and high Strain still loosen control. If the character chose Quirkless, this trait does not apply.
